name: Google Community Space
description: Free event space for member Bay Area nonprofits and local government departments, with screens and microphones; limited to one event per quarter
fullDescription: Google Community Space offers free event space in San Francisco to member Bay Area nonprofits and local city and county government departments. It is now located at Hills Plaza (courtyard entrance, Suite 140).
whatTheyOffer:
- Free event space: Main Room for up to 48 people plus a 12-person workshop room
- Screens, handheld and lapel microphones included
- Free membership for approved organizations
- Google-hosted programming for members (when available)
- One event per business quarter
- No kitchen on site (catering allowed)
howToGetIt:
1. Must be a registered 501(c)(3) in good standing or a local city/county government department in the 9 Bay Area counties
2. Apply for membership on the Google Community Space website (nonprofits are verified through Benevity)
3. Once accepted, log in to the Member Portal to request a date
4. Book up to 90 days in advance, Monday-Friday 9am-5pm
5. Upload a certificate of insurance (COI) and submit a guest list for each event
6. Schedule space (max once per quarter)
address: 2 Harrison Street, Suite 140, San Francisco, CA 94105
keywords: Google, free meeting space, nonprofit venue, San Francisco, conference room, event space, Embarcadero, technology
